details.dense_varying_rate_counterexample: On C Omega plus l2(N), H e_j=(1/j)e_j; finite-support vectors have dense span and individual positive exponential rates, but inf excited spectrum=0.
details.lemma_scope: The projection proof is analytic in the report. Finite exact controls cannot prove an interacting lattice estimate.
details.onset_counterexample: C_T(t)=1, m=1, A=1; requiring the bound only for 2T<=t<=T is vacuous while the fixed-time limit remains 1. The corrected common onset excludes this loophole.
